summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] A next-generation AI phase change memory has been developed that can control the heat generated during the memory calculation process and reduce power usage by up to 76% compared to the current level. Phase change memory refers to a non-volatile memory that stores information using the difference in electrical resistance between the crystalline and amorphous states of a material. It is attracting attention as a next-generation memory for artificial intelligence and in-memory computing due to its fast operation and ability to store multiple information in one cell. The National Research Foundation of Korea announced on the 11th that a research team led by Professor Geunsoo Kim of Korea University's Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering succeeded in implementing a double-isolated phase change heterostructure memory that gradually adjusts the heat diffusion and phase change region inside the memory by combining two types of materials with different characteristics. The research results were published in the international academic journal 'International Journal of Extremes'. It was published online in the International Journal of Extreme Manufacturing. Recently, as data processing through generative artificial intelligence (AI) and large-scale language models has rapidly increased, phase change memory has been attracting attention as a replacement technology for current memory. title_ja: AIが下げた行政しきい値…美・英苦情申請最大5倍増加
summary_ja: [ジディネットコリア]生成型人工知能（AI）が複雑な行政手続きの閾値を下げている。書類作成と情報探索をAIが代わって複雑な手続きのせいで放棄した苦情提起と各種申請も実際の受付につながっていることが明らかになった。米国消費者金融保護局（ＣＦＰＢ）の苦情も同じ期間５倍に増えた。ブラジルの司法請願とドイツ議会の請願でも同様の流れが確認された。分析した事例の多くは、2022年以前まで受付量が比較的一定だったが、その後増加速度が速くなったことが分かった。ただし研究陣はAIが受付量増加を直接起こしたという因果関係まで確認したわけではないと善を引いた。過去には必要な情報を直接集めてAIに具体的に説明しなければならなかったら、今は機関から受け取った手紙をAIアプリに貼り付けたり、写真で撮るだけでも内容を把握…。
title_en: Administrative threshold lowered by AI… Up to 5-fold increase in civil complaint applications in the US and UK
summary_en: [GD Net Korea] Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is lowering the threshold for complex administrative procedures. As AI takes over document preparation and information search, complaints and various applications that had been abandoned due to complicated procedures are now being accepted. According to Tech Crunch on the 10th (local time), the number of complaints filed with the UK Housing Ombudsman more than doubled from 2,600 in 2022 to more than 7,000 last year. Complaints to the U.S. Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) also increased fivefold during the same period. A similar trend was confirmed in Brazilian judicial petitions and petitions to the German parliament. Chris Schmitz, a doctoral researcher at the German Herti School, analyzed 84 cases ranging from welfare applications to judicial objections in 11 jurisdictions. In most of the analyzed cases, the volume of applications was relatively constant until 2022, but the rate of increase appeared to accelerate thereafter. However, the researchers drew the line by saying that they have not confirmed the causal relationship that AI directly caused the increase in the number of applications. As AI develops, the time and effort required to prepare civil complaints and various applications is also decreasing. In the past, you had to collect the necessary information yourself and explain it to AI in detail, but now you can understand the contents just by pasting the letter you received from the institution into the AI ​​app or taking a picture.
